checkpoint_selection: Netflix validation total reward; earlier step breaks ties; no YouTube selection
exact_budget: Regular 1024-step rollouts; last rollout 248 steps/environment, 992 interactions, trained normally. No discarded samples or 303104-step overshoot.

statistics.paired_design: Prespecified seed blocks across eight configurations on identical workload; dimension/algorithm changes do not create identical random streams. Five seeds are independent within each configuration, not physical replications.
statistics.primary_test: Exact two-sided sign-flip test on mean paired differences; symmetry/exchangeability assumption disclosed; five primary tests including interaction; Holm adjustment.
statistics.interval: 95% Student-t interval for mean seed-block energy difference, descriptive and normal-difference conditional with n5; not workload/model uncertainty.
statistics.secondary: Instant-vs-forecast and all SEC/reward/endpoint/YouTube comparisons descriptive; no extra significance claims

transfer: Evaluate all frozen Netflix selections and endpoints on YouTube validation only after all40 selections are frozen; target-specific external forecasting, no controller fitting/selection on YouTube.
performance_accounting: CPU process time and wall time, whole-worker peak RSS, model parameter bytes, per-call inference latency on selected validation trajectory. CPU1 thread/worker; no end-to-end NWDAF deployment claim.
comparison_to_stage4: Historical reference only: W95 vs W96 and forecast/provider-selection/cold-start changes confound direct attribution to improved forecast quality.

historical_stage4_forecast.selection: validation_rmse; prefix early stopping uses only earlier prefix internal validation
